electrical.multiplicity_scope: Three copies of the exact GUI-exported or native-extracted single-device subcircuit in electrical parallel; no physical array acceptance.

electrical.native_path: Actual unmodified fresh queued extraction. Only declared top-subcircuit name normalization may be used for safe wrapping; originals remain retained and compared.
electrical.analytic_path: Independent numerical source-derived R, loaded RC transfer/transient and thermal-noise law.
electrical.source_pilot: Explicit development mode. Source runs, incomplete selections and stale/prior-native inputs cannot satisfy installed acceptance.

provenance: Exact clean candidate Git commit and all external-checker/backend source bytes.
Actual installed executable, embedded build identity, shipped package, discovered engine and immutable physical adapter.
Fresh GUI execution nonce, original invocation, queued job/result/stage identities, all raw artifacts and masks.

completion: Both selected installed platform workflows, unchanged existing release gates and full candidate evidence binding must pass before this selected installed milestone is called complete. This does not close chunk7 or promote any catalog device.

package_rebinding.change: Package identity and source provenance only; reviewed models, equations, selections, fault controls, numerical limits and claim boundaries are unchanged.
package_rebinding.acceptance: Source preparation only. Historical evidence retains its original contract; fresh current-package native and installed acceptance remain separate.
